_README: THE KANJO LOADER — two cars trading position on a night highway.
THE VEHICLE ART SHIPPING HERE IS TEMPORARY AND NEUTRAL. car-a.svg and
car-b.svg are unbranded silhouettes: no badge, no grille, no real car. They
exist so the choreography has something to move. Replacing them is a change
to this file and nothing else — drop the final art in public/media/loader/
and point carA/carB at it. Width and height are the art's INTRINSIC pixel
size and are what stop the loader from reflowing as the images decode.
TIMING. minimumDisplayMs is a floor so a warm cache does not turn the
entrance into a flicker; one full overtake takes about 3s, so ~2200 shows a
complete trade of position. maximumDisplayMs is the ESCAPE PATH: past it
the site opens whatever is still loading. The maximum always wins if the two
are ever set to disagree.
WHAT 'READY' MEANS: hydration plus the display font. NOT every asset on the
page — a loader that waits for the hero video is a loader a slow connection
can hold open for a minute.
intensity: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high'. A phone automatically runs one step
below whatever is set here, and prefers-reduced-motion replaces the whole
sequence with a still frame and a short fade.
road: optional. A painted plate behind the generated surface. Omitted, the
highway is drawn from CSS alone and costs no request at all.
